crossRefs.note: He enters into peace. They rest in their beds, each one who walks in his uprightness.
You will know that your tent is in peace. You will visit your fold, and will miss nothing.

translations.web: He pursues them and passes by safely, even by a way that he had not gone with his feet.
translations.bsb: He pursues them, going on safely, hardly touching the path with his feet.
translations.kjv: He pursued them, and passed safely; even by the way that he had not gone with his feet.
translations.asv: He pursueth them, and passeth on safely, even by a way that he had not gone with his feet.
